question:

** Biosphere Reserve Area** 

 
 
 
 **State**

Nokrek

 
 
 
(a)

 
 
 
Odisha

 
 
 

 
 
(2)

(3)

 
 
 
Similipal

 
 
 
(c)

 
 
 
Andhra Pradesh

Seshachalam

 
 
 
(d)

 
 
 
Assam
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Nokrek Biosphere Reserve**

__
 
• It is located in the **Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.**
 
• The biosphere reserve derives its name from Nokrek Hill, the **highest peak of the Garo Hills.**
 
• The Nokrek National Park was added to the list of **biosphere reserves by UNESCO in May 2009.**

**Manas Biosphere Reserve**

 
• It is located in the **state of Assam**.
 
• Manas National Park or Manas Wildlife Sanctuary is a **national park, a UNESCO Natural World Heritage site, a Project Tiger reserve, an elephant reserve and a biosphere reserve in Assam.**
 
• It was **established **in the** year 1973 under Project Tiger.**
 
• It was accorded the status of a **UNESCO Natural World Heritage site in the year 1985.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**Simlipal Bioreserve**

 
• It was designated a **Tiger reserve in 1956.**
 
• **Simlipal Bioreserve is a part of the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve(2009).**
 
• It is located in the **northern part of Odisha’s Mayurbhanj district. **
 
• Simplipal biosphere reserve area is 4,374 sq. km. and 845 sq. km. of forest (tiger reserve), 2,129 sq. km buffer area.

**The Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve **

 
• It is located in the **Seshachalam Hill ranges of the Eastern Ghats in Southern Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The total geographical area of the Seshachalam biosphere reserve is **4755.9 km2.**
 
• Seshachalam Hills, **the first Biosphere Reserve in Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It was designated as the **Biosphere Reserves of India in 2010.**
 
• It has large reserves of **Red Sandalwood.**
 
• **Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
